3604.title: Editor storage requests lose the owning host
3604.rootCauseOneLine: The editor builds thread storage from server-local configuration and omits the owning host ID for read, tree, and write.
3604.proposedFix: Use threads.storageLocation and forward its root and host to file operations.
3604.caveats: RPC-boundary reproduction with SDK doubles; live HTTP/browser behavior and physical disk writes were not tested.
